Experiments-as-a-Service (EASI)

EASI

Adaptive Experiments builds Experiments‑As‑a‑Service Infrastructure (EASI) to make real‑world educational field experiments simple, reproducible, and effective. Lower the barrier for teachers and researchers to test instructional designs, discover what improves learning, and deploy improvements at scale.

What is EASI?

EASI is a platform that enables educators and researchers to design, run, and analyze educational experiments. It provides a suite of tools for creating and managing experiments, including randomization, data collection, and analysis. EASI is designed to be user-friendly and accessible, with a focus on making experiments easy to set up and run.

How does EASI work?

EASI works by providing a platform for educators and researchers to design and run experiments. The platform includes tools for creating and managing experiments, including randomization, data collection, and analysis. EASI is designed to be user-friendly and accessible, with a focus on making experiments easy to set up and run.

Who can use EASI?

EASI is available to educators and researchers who are interested in designing and running educational experiments. The platform is free to use, and there are no restrictions on the number of experiments that can be run.

What kind of experiments can be run on EASI?

EASI can be used to run a wide variety of experiments, including randomized controlled trials, quasi-experimental designs, and observational studies. The platform provides tools for creating and managing experiments, including randomization, data collection, and analysis.

How can I get started with EASI?

To get started with EASI, visit the UpGrade documentation and follow the instructions to create and configure your own experiment instance.

If you need assistance creating an instance or configuring an experiment, reach out to any of the project leaders for support on the Team page

What are the benefits of using EASI?

The benefits of using EASI include:

  • Ease of use: EASI is designed to be user-friendly and accessible, with a focus on making experiments easy to set up and run.
  • Flexibility: EASI can be used to run a wide variety of experiments, including randomized controlled trials, quasi-experimental designs, and observational studies.
  • Scalability: EASI is designed to handle large-scale experiments, with the ability to collect and analyze data from thousands of participants.
  • Transparency: EASI provides tools for creating and managing experiments, including randomization, data collection, and analysis.

What is the future of EASI?

The future of EASI is bright. The platform is being developed and improved all the time, and it is expected to become even more powerful and user-friendly.

How can I contribute to EASI?

You can contribute to EASI by:

  • Using the platform: Run experiments on EASI and provide feedback.
  • Improving the platform: Suggest improvements to the platform.
  • Participating in the community: Join the EASI community and share your experiences.

What is the current status of EASI?

EASI is currently in the early stages of development, and it is expected to become a powerful and user-friendly platform for educational experiments.

What are the next steps for EASI?

The next steps for EASI include:

  • Improving the platform: Suggest improvements to the platform.
  • Expanding the user base: Increase the number of users of the platform.
  • Enhancing the features: Add new features to the platform.

What is the current user base of EASI?

The current user base of EASI is small, but it is growing.
